items.title: GTA 6 Physical Copy First Look Leaked By German Retail Worker
items.summary: Photos of a German retailer's GTA 6 box show a new Lucia screenshot and a label saying the game has "online functionality" and "in-game purchases", which has fans speculating about what that means for a single-player game.

items.title: An Update On A Possible 'GTA 6' PC Release Date Plans, Due To AI
items.summary: Former Rockstar North technical director Obbe Vermeij says AI tools could get GTA 6 running on PC unofficially, which may push Rockstar to release the PC version sooner than the 19 months GTA 5 took, and GamesBeat has reported Q1 2027.

items.title: Rockstar Issues New Official Statement on GTA 6 Physical Edition
items.summary: Rockstar says physical code-in-box copies ship from November 12 with no disc, and Standard Edition owners can buy the Ultimate Edition upgrade for $20 after redeeming their code.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Will Have 55 Trophies/Achievements
items.summary: A post on social media says GTA 6 is configured with 55 PlayStation Trophies and Xbox Achievements, more than GTA 5 or RDR2 had at launch, with hints of a Platinum Trophy and an Xbox Mythic achievement.

items.title: GTA 6 PS5 Physical Boxes Have Hit The Wild, A Harbinger Of Our Disc-Less Future
items.summary: Photos of a shrink-wrapped German PS5 copy of GTA 6 with no disc inside surfaced on Reddit ahead of the November 12 retail date.

items.title: GTA 6 Physical Copies Leak Reveals Collector's Poster
items.summary: Physical code-in-box copies reportedly surfaced early via a MediaMarkt listing and a German Reddit post, showing a double-sided poster with cover art and no map, plus two new back-of-box screenshots.

items.title: GTA 6 Is Going All Out On Details You Might Never Even Notice
items.summary: GameSpot's Jake Dekker goes through the official screenshots again and finds hidden details such as iguanas, references to abandoned bridge projects and realistic scuba gear.

items.title: Rockstar Officially Comments on GTA 6's Open World
items.summary: Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told IGN that many open-world discoveries are emergent and won't be marked by map icons or objectives.

items.title: Is Kodak Black in GTA 6? Rapper's Grand Theft Auto Cameo, Explained
items.summary: Fans spotted rapper Kodak Black, tattoos included, in the new launch gallery screenshots, which suggests he is playing himself in the game.

items.title: GTA 6 Boss Talks The Game's Budget And Calls Out A "High-Profile" Game For Releasing In A Rough State
items.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told the WSJ that GTA 6 was expensive and took a long time, and he appeared to take a swipe at a rival game that had to be pulled after a rough launch.
